snippets.snippet_text: «¡Hola! En este enlace puedes ver los métodos de pago disponibles. Veo que estás en Perú, por lo que en tu caso tienes disponible la opción de pago con tarjeta o PayPal. ¡Un saludo!»

possible_subjects: Domestika buyer payment options by country
intake_notes: Staff response identifying Peru payment options as card or PayPal only as of December 2020. Notably, no local/cash payment available for Peru at that time.
current_vs_historical_ambiguity: December 2020 data. Domestika expanded dLocal integration to more LATAM markets after this date; Peru may now have additional options.
Low priority: data is over 5 years old and likely outdated for current payment method mapping.
